title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I got in touch with Jerry about fantasy camp. Let’s see about setting something up with an early arriving player during one of those weekends, for the season preview.
I suspect it will be a tough sell if they’re sending me down there just for fantasy camp. Have a merry Christmas, tell the future GM, too.
Sounds good. Happy Holidays to you! Future GM says Merry Christmas
